# Project vocabulary. Words listed here are accepted as spelled.
#
# Vale.Spelling reports every word its dictionary does not know, so this list exists to keep
# those reports meaningful: add a term when it is deliberate, not to silence a typo or paper
# over an awkward phrasing. It also names deliberate terms the current dictionary happens to
# know, so a dictionary update cannot turn them into findings.
